description: Bootstrapped reports whether a chain has finished bootstrapping on this node.

chain.description: Chain is the alias or id of the chain to ask about.

name: get_chain_bootstrapped

description: ChainID resolves a chain's alias to the id it names.

alias.description: Alias is the name the chain answers to, such as "X".

name: get_chain_id

description:
Chains are the chains this node is running, which is a subset of the chains
the P-Chain knows about.
name: get_chains

description: Fees are the transaction fees this node charges, in nLUX.
name: get_fees

description: LPs is where the network's stake stands on every current Lux Proposal.
name: get_lps

description: NetworkID is the number of the network this node is on.
name: get_network_id

description: NetworkName is the name of the network this node is on.
name: get_network_name

description:
Identity is this node's id, with the proof it holds the staking key that id is
derived from.
name: get_node_id

description: Address is where this node tells its peers to reach it.
name: get_node_ip

description:
NodeVersion is what this node is running: its own release, the database format
it reads, and the VM protocol it speaks.
name: get_node_version

description:
Peers are the nodes this one is connected to. A list of node ids narrows the
answer to those, and no list asks for all of them.

nodeIDs.description: NodeIDs are the peers to answer for; none asks for all of them.

name: get_peers

description: Upgrades is the upgrade schedule this node runs.
name: get_upgrades

description: Uptime is how much of the network, by stake, reports having seen this node up.
name: get_uptime

description:
VMs are the virtual machines installed on this node, and the feature
extensions its UTXO chains understand.
name: get_vms
